scope: Four field-rate diagnostics, nine guard transport theorems, one full-difference-energy guard bound, and two time-derivative theorems: the exact pointwise difference-density chain rule and passage of its derivative through the fixed cell integral at interior times under explicit joint rate-density continuity. The integrated stress/diffusion balance, remaining estimates, PDE existence and uniqueness remain open.
open_items: Construct local coupled variable-viscosity PDE solutions in an appropriate spatial function space.
Prove continuation/global estimates for the every-finite-horizon existence target.

Derive the remaining integrated two-history stress, pressure and diffusion identities, guard invariant range, and transport/reaction estimates; the time interchange now has an explicit extra rate-density regularity hypothesis.
Formalize the full classical uniqueness argument and specify its relation to the saved solution class.
Submit actual existence and uniqueness proofs to Comparator.
